title: ELISA assay with contaminated plate P4 skewing raw mean
what: clean treated-vs-control lift (~+0.26 OD, ~+62%) after excluding contaminated plate P4

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: Across clean plates P1–P3 and P5, treated averages 0.67 OD vs control 0.41 OD (+0.26 OD, +63%).

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; on the four valid plates, replicate scatter (~0.025 OD SD) is tiny compared to the +0.26 OD signal increase.

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: Plate P4 is flagged for washer malfunction/contaminated blank (~1.8–1.9 OD) and severely skews the pooled mean if not excluded.
